ValidationRule.description: This rule will validate that the Beneficial Ownership task was marked as completed prior to the funder acknowledging the checklist if Beneficial Ownership information is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Merchant_Checklist_Acknowledged__c = TRUE, Beneficial_Ownership_N__c = TRUE, Beneficial_Ownership_C__c = FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before acknowledging that this Merchant Checklist is complete the Beneficial Ownership step must be completed.
